title: Rory and the Blossom Grove
verses:
The moon floated high over moss-covered trees,
As Rory walked slowly along by the stream.
The leaves softly rustled in evening's sweet breeze,
And filled every heart with a slumberous dream.

Then Ricky ran up with a skip and a bound,
While Nia flew down from the shadowy crest.
They gathered around on the carpeted ground,
To search for a meadow where all could find rest.

Now Benny stepped forward to show them the way,
And Psittaco snuggled in Tilly's soft fold.
They left the last light of the fading red day,
To wander through hills that were painted in gold.

A canopy made of wild blossoms above,
Was glowing with lantern-bugs shining so bright.
The friends rested close in a circle of love,
Surrounded by shadows of peaceful blue night.

Now Rory yawned wide as he curled on the floor,
While Benny breathed out a long, comforting sigh.
A sleepy breeze hummed through the valley once more,
While starlight fell down from the velvety sky.

So warm in the grove, all the dinosaurs slept,
As quiet rolled over the hilltops and glades.
While dream-whispers over the drowsy earth crept,
Soft slumber embraced them in silvery shades.
